suites.title: Mandatory 12 Scenarios: Hearts Persistence, Background Regeneration & Guest Restrictions

specs.title: Scenario 1: Login with 5 hearts, close the app, wait 10+ minutes, reopen: balance must be 6
Scenario 2: Close the app for 30 minutes: balance must increase by 3, subject to the 100-heart cap
Scenario 3: Reopen repeatedly: hearts and countdown must never reset
Scenario 4: Switch devices and log in: same account balance and regeneration state must appear
Scenario 5: Log out and log back in: regeneration must reflect actual elapsed time
Scenario 6: Reach 100 hearts: no further regeneration
Scenario 7: Start with 99 hearts and wait 10 minutes: balance must become 100, never 101
Scenario 8: Guest starts with 10 hearts: no regeneration under any circumstances
Scenario 9: Guest consumes all 10 hearts: learning must be blocked until login/signup
Scenario 10: Refresh, restart, clear frontend state, and attempt API manipulation: guest restrictions must remain enforced
Scenario 11: Concurrent sessions, simultaneous requests, and rapid answer submissions for race conditions
Scenario 12: Existing users balances and learning progress are not lost during migration
